items.question: Is AppEvents free?
items.answer: Yes — it's free to create and publish your invitation right now.

items.question: What kinds of events can I create?
Can guests RSVP?
items.answer: Yes — every published invitation has a built-in RSVP form, and you can see who's confirmed or declined from your dashboard.

items.question: Can I edit my invitation after publishing?
items.answer: Yes, anytime. Changes go live immediately at the same link.

items.question: Is there a limit on guests?
items.answer: No — share your one link with as many guests as you like.

items.question: Is the invitation available in other languages?
items.answer: Yes — Portuguese, English, and Spanish. Each guest picks their language right on the invitation page.

Wedding.metaDescription: Create a digital wedding invitation with an interactive envelope, countdown, RSVP and one-tap ready-made reminders. Free to start.
Wedding.heroHeading: The wedding invitation your guests will actually open
Wedding.heroSubtitle: An interactive digital envelope, a full ceremony-and-reception timeline, and organized RSVPs — all in one link.
Wedding.painPoint: A guest list scattered across WhatsApp groups, with no clear picture of who is confirmed.
Wedding.solution: Your RSVP list updates itself with every response, and you send a ready-made email or WhatsApp reminder with one tap to anyone who hasn't replied yet.

faq.question: Do I have to pay to create the invitation?
faq.answer: No. Creating and publishing your wedding invitation is free.

faq.question: Do guests need to install an app?
faq.answer: No — the invitation opens straight in the browser, from a single link, on any phone.

faq.question: Can I see who has confirmed?
faq.answer: Yes. You track the guest list in real time and can send email or WhatsApp reminders to anyone who has not responded.

Birthday.metaDescription: Create an online birthday invitation in minutes: photos, countdown and organized RSVPs. Free to start.
Birthday.heroHeading: A digital birthday invitation, ready in minutes
Birthday.heroSubtitle: Pick a theme, add photos, and share an elegant link — no paper invite, no hassle.
Birthday.painPoint: An expensive paper invite, or a plain message lost in the family group chat.
Birthday.solution: An invitation with a real visual identity, party photos, and a guest list that is always up to date.

faq.question: Do I have to pay to create the invitation?
faq.answer: No. Creating and publishing your birthday invitation is free.

faq.question: Can I use photos of the birthday person?
faq.answer: Yes, you can add a cover photo and a photo gallery to the invitation.

faq.question: How do I know who is coming?
faq.answer: The invitation has built-in RSVP, and you track confirmations right from your dashboard.

Graduation.metaDescription: Replace the graduation PDF with a digital invitation with a timeline, mapped address and RSVP. Free to start.
Graduation.heroHeading: A graduation invitation without a heavy PDF on WhatsApp
Graduation.heroSubtitle: One link, with a full ceremony timeline, a mapped address, and organized RSVPs.
Graduation.painPoint: A heavy PDF that jams up WhatsApp, and no one is sure of the actual ceremony time.
Graduation.solution: An invitation with a full event timeline, an integrated map, and a guest list that is always visible.

faq.question: Do I have to pay to create the invitation?
faq.answer: No. Creating and publishing your graduation invitation is free.

faq.question: Can I add the ceremony and reception times?
faq.answer: Yes, the invitation includes a timeline for the event's key moments.

faq.question: Can guests see the location on a map?
faq.answer: Yes, the address links directly to Google Maps and Waze.

FifteenYearsParty.metaDescription: Create an elegant digital invitation for a 15th birthday, with an event timeline, dress code and countdown. Free to start.
FifteenYearsParty.heroHeading: An elegant digital invitation for the big day
FifteenYearsParty.heroSubtitle: A full event timeline, a dress code section, and a countdown — an invitation worthy of the occasion.
FifteenYearsParty.painPoint: An expensive printed invite with no room to explain the night's schedule (waltz, dinner, tributes).
FifteenYearsParty.solution: An invitation with an event timeline, a dedicated dress code section, and a countdown building anticipation.

faq.question: Do I have to pay to create the invitation?
faq.answer: No. Creating and publishing the invitation is free.

faq.question: Can I add the party's dress code?
faq.answer: Yes, the invitation has a dedicated field for the expected attire.

faq.question: Can I show the night's schedule (waltz, dinner, etc.)?
faq.answer: Yes, you can build a timeline with the key moments of the night.

BabyShower.metaDescription: Create an online baby shower invitation with an organized guest list and one-tap RSVP reminders. Free to start.
BabyShower.heroHeading: A baby shower invitation without WhatsApp group chaos
BabyShower.heroSubtitle: An organized guest list, with ready-made email and WhatsApp reminders you send with one tap to anyone who hasn't replied yet.
BabyShower.painPoint: A WhatsApp group full of messages, with no clear picture of who is actually coming.
BabyShower.solution: A real guest list, with each person's status tracked, and a ready-made reminder you send with one tap — no need to chase anyone individually.

faq.question: Do I have to pay to create the invitation?
faq.answer: No. Creating and publishing your baby shower invitation is free.

faq.question: How do I remind guests who have not confirmed?
faq.answer: You can send an email reminder right from your dashboard, or use a ready-made WhatsApp link with the message already written.

faq.question: Can I add photos?
faq.answer: Yes, the invitation has room for a cover photo and a photo gallery.
